sergei-mikhailov-stt version 1.0.0

- Initial release providing speech-to-text conversion for Telegram voice messages.
- Supports audio file validation and processing (OGG, WAV, MP3) using ffmpeg.
- Integrates Yandex SpeechKit as the default STT provider, with the option to add more providers.
- Handles file size, format verification, error reporting, and usage of environment-based API credentials.
- Provides structured results including recognized text, language, confidence, provider, and processing time information.
